subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the parenthesis. .5  10 =
stimulus: Not only over the (a) coast areas, but also over other parts of the country (b) cyclone storm blows every year causing a great damages to life and property. Very often, an (c) reparable loss paralyses the economy of the country. A lot of money is spent for (d) reconstruct work. It is a matter or regret that in these circumstances relief goods are not (e) proper distributed among the victims. This is (f) doubt very (g) fortune. So, we have to (h) move all (i) regularities and (j) managements regarding natural disasters.
guide_solution: (a) coastal (b) cyclonic (c) irreparable (d) reconstructing (e) properly (f) undoubtedly/ doubtlessly (g) unfortunate (h) remove (i) irregularities (j) mismanagements
